tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.1.1 — English Default UI Localization with Dynamic Language Toggle
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.1.1 configures English as the default UI language across all menus, toolbars, buttons, tooltips, dialogs, and the Windows Setup Wizard, while introducing a dynamic one-click language toggle (🌐 עברית / English) for instant runtime switching.
features: English Default Interface: All application menus, buttons, tooltips, and dialogs now display in clean English by default.
Dynamic Language Switcher: Added a top-toolbar '🌐 עברית / English' button to instantly toggle between English and Hebrew at runtime.
English Windows Setup Wizard: The installer wizard displays in clear English by default with standard navigation controls.
Multi-User Handwriting Profiles: Dedicated isolated learning memory banks for different scribes and students.
Multi-Profile Stacking: Combine rules from multiple people simultaneously during OCR scans.
One-Click Backup & Restore: Instant timestamped backups, safe restores, and colleague rule merging.
100% Offline & Roaming Profile Compatible: Runs locally on CPU with zero internet connection required.
